headline: European wheat futures drop near multi-month lows on peace talks
summary: European wheat futures drifted lower, approaching multi-month lows as market sentiment reacted to ongoing peace talks.
why: Agricultural commodity prices directly impact global food inflation, farm incomes, and the input costs for consumer packaged goods companies.

impacts.name: European wheat
impacts.why: Geopolitical peace negotiations ease supply disruption fears, lowering wheat futures.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Diplomatic peace talks reduced supply risk premiums associated with regional conflict zones, driving European wheat prices down to multi-month lows.
